title: Crystallization of the Mg-releasing intermediates of kinesin ATPase
protocol: Dialyze purified KIF1A solution against buffer A using Slide-A-Lyzer dialysis cassette for more than an hour.
Concentrate the dialyzed KIF1A solution to 40-80 mg/ml using Amicon Ultra centrifugal filter device.
Add 2-, 4-, or 10-fold excess apyrase to the concentrated KIF1A solution, keep on ice for 30 min and centrifuge at 20,000 g to eliminate aggregates.
Mix 2 μl of apyrase-mixed KIF1A solution with 2 μl reservoir buffer.
Dispense the mixture in hanging drops over 500 μl well solutions containing the reservoir buffer.
Harvest crystals using cryoloop every 24 hours from day when crystal appears to day when crystal disappears.
Flash-freeze harvested crystals immediately in cold nitrogen stream at -175°C.
